If you think the exact-set rule belongs there anyway, it would mean giving the JS engine a command layer, and I would want that ruled rather than assumed.
Should a subscribed channel be one socket or two?
demultiplexing in every client; two makes ordering between a reply and a push unspecified. I built one and correlated; I would rather you ruled it before a WebView is written against it.
What should a projection that outgrows the frame do?
Today: a named refusal, and the

channel gets no world. The alternatives are paging, or a projection that degrades by dropping its largest lists and saying so. Refusing is honest and leaves an agent with nothing; degrading is useful and is a projection that lies by omission unless the omission is in the frame.
